title: A Homeless Man Returned $42,000 And Got $150,000 Back
description: Glen James had nothing, found a backpack full of money, and gave every dollar back. Source: https://www.wcvb.com/article/honest-homeless-man-meets-man-who-set-up-fund/8189146 Would you have handed it back? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime #truestory #history

characters.Glen James: Black American man in his 50s, short graying hair and a short gray beard, tired kind eyes, worn olive-green canvas jacket over a gray hooded sweatshirt, faded blue jeans, scuffed brown work boots, no hat
characters.Ethan Whittington: 27-year-old white American man, short neat brown hair, light stubble, light blue button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, dark gray slacks, brown leather shoes, no hat
characters.Officer: Boston police officer, man in his 40s, short black hair, plain dark navy uniform shirt and trousers, no hat

scenes.say: A homeless man found forty-two thousand dollars, and nobody was watching. Glen James, Boston, September 2013. A lost backpack at a shopping plaza. Cash, traveler's checks, a stranger's passport.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Outside the South Bay shopping plaza in Boston on an overcast September afternoon, Glen James walks alone along the sidewalk past parked cars. [4-7s] At the edge of the South Bay plaza parking lot, close-up of a plain dark blue backpack lying beside a bench; Glen stops. [7-10s] On the bench at the South Bay plaza, Glen opens the backpack a little and his eyes widen at thick bundles of plain cash inside.

scenes.say: He'd been homeless for eight years, ever since losing his job as a file clerk at a Boston courthouse. That money could have bought a way out. But he flagged down police.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Faded flashback inside a quiet Boston courthouse records room, a younger Glen James in a white shirt and tie slides a plain folder into a metal cabinet. [4-7s] Back on the bench at the South Bay plaza, close-up of Glen's hands resting on the closed dark blue backpack, thumbs still. [7-10s] On the sidewalk outside the South Bay plaza, Glen stands up and raises a hand to wave down the Officer walking toward him.

scenes.say: The owner got every dollar back. Police gave Glen a citation, and he handed reporters a note: 'Even if I were desperate for money, I would not have kept even a penny.'
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the sidewalk outside the South Bay plaza, Glen James hands the dark blue backpack to the Officer, who looks at him in surprise. [4-7s] Inside a plain room at a Boston police station, the Officer shakes Glen's hand; Glen looks down shyly. [7-10s] In the same police station room, close-up of Glen holding a small folded white note against his chest, a small proud smile.

scenes.say: Hundreds of miles away in Virginia, a 27-year-old named Ethan Whittington read that story and couldn't let it go. He'd never been to Boston. He'd never met Glen.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a small apartment kitchen in Midlothian, Virginia at night, Ethan Whittington sits at the table reading on a laptop, seen from behind, only a soft screen glow. [4-7s] In the same kitchen, close-up of Ethan's face lit by the screen as he slowly puts a hand over his mouth. [7-10s] In the same kitchen, Ethan leans back in his chair and stares at the dark window, thinking.

scenes.say: So he started an online fundraiser. His math was simple: Glen gave back forty thousand, so he deserved fifty. The goal was gone in a day. Then strangers kept giving.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the Midlothian apartment kitchen, Ethan Whittington types fast on the laptop, a coffee mug beside him, the screen turned away from the camera. [4-7s] On a park bench in Virginia at lunchtime, Ethan presses a phone to his ear and laughs in disbelief. [7-10s] Back in the Midlothian kitchen at dawn, Ethan has fallen asleep at the table beside the open glowing laptop, smiling.

scenes.say: More than six thousand people donated. Ethan came to Boston and hugged Glen, who soon moved into housing. He'd returned forty-two thousand dollars, and strangers sent back over one hundred fifty thousand.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On a quiet Boston street outside a small cafe in October, Ethan Whittington and Glen James meet, shake hands, then Ethan pulls Glen into a hug. [4-7s] On the same Boston street, close-up of Glen's face over Ethan's shoulder, eyes wet, a small smile. [7-10s] Inside a small sunlit apartment in Cambridge, Glen sets a plain dark blue backpack down on his own bed and looks around the quiet room.
